widget.title: Analytics
settings.title: Analytics settings
settings.intro: Choose what is counted, keep analytics out of backups, and delete collected data.
settings.tracking_help: When off, no tracking script is added to your pages and nothing new is recorded. Collected data is kept.
settings.exclude_help: One path prefix per line, each starting with /. These are plain prefixes: /shop also matches /shopping and /shop/cart.
settings.backup_help: Backups then skip analytics.db. It is included by default.
settings.geo.title: Countries (GeoIP)
settings.geo.found: Found: visitors are counted by country.
settings.geo.missing: Missing: every country shows as unknown.
settings.geo.help: To count countries, put a MaxMind GeoLite2 Country file here and restart GoRun:
settings.delete.title: Delete data
settings.delete.intro: Deleting cannot be undone. The file is compacted afterwards.
settings.delete.all_help: Removes every visit, submission and daily total.
settings.error_exclude: Each excluded path must start with / and contain no spaces (at most 200 lines).
settings.error_confirm: Nothing was deleted: type the confirmation word exactly.
settings.error_date: Nothing was deleted: choose a date that is not in the future.
